approval.note: Latency numbers are plan section 10 (P95 <= 8 s, compile/policy <= 250 ms). Concurrency, token, cost, and fairness gates are the implementing agent's proposals. The plan requires latency and cost to be re-baselined for the selected staging model and warehouse. Not approved. Cost ceilings were set from the reference stack's own estimates (25 to 200 uncalibrated units per answer) and a modest analyst workload (100 answers a day); they are placeholders until real prices and usage exist.

gate_plan.p95_warm_latency_seconds: P95 warm answer latency, local reference data <= 8 seconds
gate_plan.concurrent_errors_or_wrong_rows: No errors or wrong rows under concurrency: 0
gate_plan.prompt_tokens_per_intent_max: Context tokens per intent stay within the run's context budget
gate_plan.cost_per_answer_usd: Unit economics: assumed cost per answered question within the proposed ceiling
gate_plan.warehouse_cost_units_per_answer: Warehouse cost units per answer (mean over the question mix) within the proposed ceiling
gate_plan.answers_per_tenant_day: The proposed daily cost budget affords a tenant at least this many answers a day
gate_plan.quiet_tenant_denials: A noisy neighbour does not deny a quiet tenant: 0
gate_plan.noisy_tenant_over_quota: A tenant above its quota is held to it: 0 admissions above the allowed

assumed_prices.note: PLACEHOLDERS chosen by the implementing agent so that unit economics can be computed; not quotes from any provider or warehouse. Replace with the selected model and warehouse prices.

not_measured.real_model_latency: the model is scripted and instant; a real model call typically dominates latency and cost and is the largest unknown
not_measured.real_warehouse: DuckDB over a 100-row table and an emulated PostgreSQL say nothing about warehouse latency, scan cost, or concurrency
not_measured.target_load: no target load is declared; 8 concurrent workers on one process is a smoke test, not a capacity test
not_measured.control_store: the control store is SQLite in a local file; PostgreSQL contention and connection pooling are not measured
not_measured.infrastructure_cost: compute, storage, network, and observability costs are not modelled; only model tokens and warehouse cost units are
not_measured.token_baseline: the plan's -20% target is against the ADS-007 baseline, which this evaluation does not compare to (see ADS-072 for the retrieval-side token reduction)
